scope.primary_claim: At one explicitly configured sandbox delegate boundary, a context-bound gate is evaluated for observed forbidden-effect prevention and useful permitted work.

research_questions.question: How do five matched fixed-action arms change observed forbidden effects and useful allowed work?
For each preregistered mutation, is the outcome admit, deny, abstain, failure, timeout, or observed effect?
How constraints alter closed-loop planning and recovery.

population.rationale: Thirty lineage-independent families provide three bounded source populations while the 900-attempt CPU-only budget remains feasible. This is not a power guarantee.

split_rules.assignment: hash(lineage_family_id, published_split_salt) recorded in the frozen split manifest
atomic_groups: all derivatives of an original source
CVE vulnerable/fixed pair and all controls/patches
SkillCenter base procedure and all variants/chunks/embeddings/normalizations
legal provision and all extracted clauses, variants, and labels

arms.name: unguarded_sandbox
arms.control: direct sandbox invocation with effect observer

arms.name: lightweight_policy_plus_ucan
arms.control: A2 plus declared policy and capability-envelope checks

arms.name: full_enforcement
arms.control: A3 plus explicit ENFORCE and exact context/root/clock/consumption binding
arms.does_not_claim: solver proof, durable consumption, or complete mediation

fixed_action_plan.analysis_unit_rule: Seeds and paired cases are retained within, not treated as independent beyond, a lineage-family summary.

reporting_rules: Timeouts, failures, not-started attempts, and unobserved effects are reported rather than dropped.
A failure or timeout is never evidence of a safe denial.
Every rate reports numerator and denominator; n=0 is undefined, not zero.
Retries retain the original record and cannot overwrite it.

statistics.method: paired lineage-family summary; stratified cluster bootstrap
